high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram Reels post. The photo captures a serene sunset scene at the beach. The sky is painted with warm hues of orange and yellow, transitioning into a darker blue as it meets the horizon. The sun is positioned low on the horizon, casting a golden glow over the ocean. In the foreground, there is a person standing in the shallow water, facing away from the camera. The individual appears to be adjusting their hair or headwear, with their hands raised above their head.
